capabilities.business_description: List accounting capabilities visible to the bound user and company.
Read a posted-only ledger-cumulative trial balance for an explicit company and inclusive date range, with explicit off-balance, zero-account, account, pagination, and company-currency choices.

Read every posted receivable debit or credit item open at an explicit Odoo accounting date, using the current reconciliation graph and keeping company-currency and transaction-currency residuals separate; the staged implementation fails closed above 10000 source candidates rather than truncating a financial result.

Read every posted payable debit or credit item open at an explicit Odoo accounting date, including vendor bills, refunds and payable payment lines, using the current reconciliation graph and keeping company-currency and transaction-currency residuals separate; the staged implementation fails closed above 10000 source candidates rather than truncating a financial result.
Create and verify a customer invoice through the controlled write state machine.
Create and verify a vendor bill through the controlled write state machine.
Create a controlled customer credit note or vendor debit note linked to its origin.

Register a company-currency inbound or outbound payment, fail closed for FX, cash-basis tax, or ambiguous multi-target partial allocation, and verify the exact target, payment, partial, and full-reconcile graph against the approved before snapshot.

Import one complete company-currency Odoo bank statement checkpoint with immutable source identities, signed foreign transaction amounts when present, duplicate rejection, Odoo-computed and source-date provenance, posted move receipts, and exact company-currency balance verification; foreign-currency journals remain disabled pending an approved rate preview.

Reconcile explicitly selected company-currency debit and credit move lines, fail closed for FX, cash-basis, or tax-bearing graphs, and verify every source parent move and journal item plus the exact partial, full, and approved write-off graph.
Read tax report lines for a company and filing period with source drill-down receipt.
Create an asset from an eligible fixed or non-current asset journal item; staging stays blocked until an Odoo 19 Enterprise canonical depreciation schedule receipt is verified.
Post the explicitly approved Odoo asset schedule move at its period end and verify the complete schedule, accounts, balance and asset residual delta.
Create an accrual journal entry with an explicit reversal date.
Post one eligible source invoice or bill line; staging stays blocked until an Odoo 19 Enterprise canonical deferred schedule receipt is verified.
Create a balanced period-end adjustment with close-period checks.
Read an Odoo financial report with explicit company, period, comparison, and currency context.
Read a consolidated view across explicitly allowed companies without mixing unauthorized records.

Read posted, ledger-cumulative account balances through an inclusive cutoff for one explicit company, preserving booked company-currency balance and transaction-currency amount separately while disclosing both transaction and company cutoff-date Odoo technical-rate sources and their verified conversion ratio; off-balance accounts are excluded.
Reverse an eligible posted journal entry with explicit date, journal, and reason.

Cancel one explicitly bound pristine V3 draft customer invoice or vendor bill through the normal approved write state machine; reject any prior posting, hash, EDI, payment, reconciliation, asset, purchase, sale, stock, analytic, cross-company, or fingerprint drift evidence.
Diagnose an accounting operation using audit events, Odoo receipts, and verification failures.

Resolve one failed-verification accounting incident by executing its receipt-bound compensating plan as a distinct approved operation without mutating the failed origin history; completed origins and execution-only failures are not eligible.
